reason: Conversation 1 gave a full, sensible troubleshooting sequence up front: explained 4C as a supply fault, checked tap and kink, and included the safety steps of switching off, unplugging, turning the tap off and using a towel before removing the hose. It also tied the water company works to the clogged filter, explained the buzz, and gave useful prevention advice with a sensible escalation path to the inlet valve or an engineer. Conversation 2 reached the same fix but was terse, gave less safety guidance (no tap-off or towel), ignored the buzz, and did not link the street works to the blockage or give any prevention advice, so it was less informative though still correct.
